text.en:
This Executive Order shall take effect upon
its promulgation.
Done in the City of Manila, this 8th day of December,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty, and
of the Independence of the Philippines, the fifth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
TEODORO EVANGELISTA
Executive Secretary
